SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 2, Special Branch.
REPORT
Date. May 24, 1935.

S. B. REGISTRY.
File No. D 6742

Subject...Anonymous letter regarding alleged communist residing in
20/299, Seymour Road.

Made by. D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa. Forwarded by. B. B. Evrard. D.C.

With reference to the attached letters written in
the Chinese language addressed to the Political Section
and the Special Branch of the French Police and the
Municipal Police respectively regarding an alleged communist
residing at 20/299, Seymour Road, I have to report the
following result of discreet enquiries made by the Chinese
staff attached to Section 2:-

The address in question is a Chinese dwelling house
situated in an alleyway on Seymour Road to the south of
Nanyang Road. The tenants of the house are Ling Shien
Wen (凌希文), the alleged communist, and a man named Tsang
( 7号 ) who have occupied the house since April, 1934.

Ling Shien Wen, age about 30, native of Wusieh, has
been an investigating officer in the employ of the Education
Bureau of the Shanghai City Government for over one year and
is closely associated with Mr. Pan Kung Chai, Chief of the
Education Bureau. He is concurrently a member of the
Executive Committee of the Third District Kuomintang Branch.
He occupies the upstairs portion of the Eastern Wing of
the premises while the other co-tenant named Tsang is
occupying the upstairs portion of the house.

A discreet watch was kept in the vicinity of No.20/299,
Seymour Road, on May 18, 19 and 20, by Chinese detectives
attached to this office but nothing of a suspicious nature
was observed.

Kuh Pao-hwa
D. I.

Deputy Commissioner (Special Branch).

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
第二科，特别支部。
报告
日期：1935年5月24日。

特别支部登记处。
档案号 D 6742

事由……关于据称居住在西摩路299弄20号的共产主义者的匿名信。

呈报人：侦探员顾宝华（Kuh Pao-hwa）。转呈人：副督察长 B. B. Evrard。

关于附上的中文信件，该信分别致函法国警察政治科及本局特别支部，举报一名据称居住在西摩路299弄20号的共产主义者，兹报告本局第二科所属华籍职员进行秘密调查的结果如下：

该地址系位于南阳路以南西摩路一条弄堂内的中式住宅。该房屋的租户为据称是共产主义者的凌希文（Ling Shien Wen）以及一名姓曾（Tsang）的男子（7号），二人自1934年4月起租用该房屋。

凌希文，年龄约30岁，籍贯无锡，受雇于上海市政府教育局担任调查员已逾一年，与教育局局长潘公展先生关系密切。他同时兼任国民党第三区党部执行委员。他居住在该处所东翼的楼上部分，而另一名合租者姓曾的男子则居住在该房屋的楼上部分。

5月18日、19日和20日，本局所属华籍侦探在西摩路299弄20号附近进行了秘密监视，但未发现任何可疑情况。

顾宝华
侦探员

副督察长（特别支部）。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 2, Special Branch
REPORT
File No. REGIST
D 6742
Shih, 35
Date May 17, 1935.

Subject Anonymous letter regarding alleged communist residing in
20/299, Seymour Road.

Made by and Forwarded by D. I. Everest

I forward herewith a letter written in the Chinese
language and addressed to the Political Section of the French
Police, which was handed to me by Sergeant Colin at 10.30 a.m.
May 17.
A translation of the letter is as follows :-
"Political Section,
French Municipal Council.
I confidentially inform you that Ling
"Shien Jen (凌震人), residing at No.20, Lane 299, Seymour
"Road, is Chief of the Shanghai Special District Youth
"Department of the Soviet Government and is conspiring
"with juvenile workers to endeavour to start a big riot
"here on the 30th Inst. Please detail efficient
"detectives to make an investigation, and to effect a
"search and arrest by special methods. This affects
"the peace and good order of the community.
(Signed) Member of the Nanking Road
Street Union."

An examination of the postal cancellation stamp on the
envelope shows that the letter was posted in Shanghai on May 17.

D. I. Everest
D. I.

D.C. (Special Branch)
S2, Please keep under
observation and then decide
upon action.
D. I. Everest
17 MAY 1935
D. I. Kuh 18/5/35

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
第二科，特别支部
报告
档案号 REGIST
D 6742
Shih, 35
日期 1935年5月17日。

事由 关于据称居住在西摩路299弄20号的共产主义者的匿名信。

呈报人及转呈人：侦探员 Everest

现转呈一封中文信件，该信致函法国警察政治科，由 Colin 巡长于5月17日上午10时30分交予本人。
信件译文如下：
“法国公董局政治科，
我机密地通知你们，居住在西摩路299弄20号的
凌震人（Ling Shien Jen），系苏维埃政府上海特区青年部
主任，正与共党青年工人密谋，企图于本月30日在此地
发动大规模暴动。请派遣得力侦探进行调查，并采取
特殊手段进行搜查和逮捕。此事关乎
社区的和平与良好秩序。
（签名）南京路街道工会会员。”

检查信封上的邮戳显示，该信于5月17日在上海寄出。

Everest
侦探员

副督察长（特别支部）
S2，请保持监视，随后决定
采取行动。
侦探员 Everest
1935年5月17日
侦探员顾（Kuh） 1935年5月18日
